import itertools, time
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t0=time.time()
U={'eps^p':(lambda p,e: e**p[0],[1.0]),
   '1-exp(-p e)':(lambda p,e: 1-np.exp(-p[0]*e),[1.0]),
   'log(e+p)':(lambda p,e: np.log(np.abs(e)+abs(p[0])+1e-9),[0.5]),
   'e/(p+e)':(lambda p,e: e/(abs(p[0])+e),[1.0]),
   'exp(-p e)':(lambda p,e: np.exp(-p[0]*e),[0.5])}
V={'exp(-qT)':(lambda q,t: np.exp(-q[0]*t),[0.5]),
   '1-exp(-qT)':(lambda q,t: 1-np.exp(-q[0]*t),[0.5]),
   'T^q':(lambda q,t: t**q[0],[1.0]),
   '1/(1+qT)':(lambda q,t: 1/(1+abs(q[0])*t),[0.5]),
   'exp(-q/T)':(lambda q,t: np.exp(-abs(q[0])/t),[0.5]),
   'tanh(qT)':(lambda q,t: np.tanh(q[0]*t),[0.5])}
terms=[(un,vn) for un in U for vn in V]
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
def termval(tn,p,q):
    return U[tn[0]][0](p,eps)*V[tn[1]][0](q,T)
def fitcombo(combo,restarts=2):
    best=None
    for k in range(restarts):
        x0=[]
        for tn in combo:
            x0+=[U[tn[0]][1][0]*(1+0.3*rng.standard_normal()), V[tn[1]][1][0]*(1+0.3*rng.standard_normal())]
        def res(x):
            X=np.column_stack([termval(tn,[x[2*i]],[x[2*i+1]]) for i,tn in enumerate(combo)])
            c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
            return X@c-sigma
        try:
            r=least_squares(res,np.array(x0),max_nfev=200)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    return best
results=[]
for combo in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(terms,3):
    if time.time()-t0>13: break
    b=fitcombo(combo)
    if b is not None and np.isfinite(b.cost): results.append((2*b.cost/len(sigma)/np.var(sigma),combo,b.x))
results.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
print(len(results), round(time.time()-t0,1))
for r in results[:6]: print(r[0], r[1], np.round(r[2],3))
